title: Melee conventions: HSD helpers, assert macros, union arms, padding, and symbol metadata
summary: In Melee, expanded jobj.h asserts map back to the HSD_JObjSet*/HSD_JObjGet* helpers and local inline forms; GET_JOBJ is used only when local evidence supports that access shape, and copied_jobj_inline rejects pasted jobj.h bodies in src/melee/**/*.c.
Raw assert/report expansions become HSD_ASSERT, HSD_ASSERTMSG, HSD_ASSERTREPORT, OSReport, or OSPanic whenever file, line, message, and side effects match; there is no exception.

Fighter, item, and stage accesses use the owning FighterVars/ItemVars/GroundVars union arm; borrowing another family's arm because offsets line up is rejected, and stage_ground_var_owner lints src/melee/gr/gr*.c.
PAD_STACK(N) is the only accepted stack-padding form and is retained only with recorded objdiff evidence; manual UNUSED u8 sp_pad[N] buffers are rejected.
Evidenced symbol renames land in config/GALE01/symbols.txt, never behind a #define alias, and python configure.py --require-protos runs when prototype or include surfaces change.
provenance: Split out of the global header-inlines, assert-report-macros, typed-fields-over-pointer-math, matching-tactics-need-evidence, truthful-headers-and-includes, and conservative-naming records so the global set is game-neutral (audits/sms-worktree-source-quality-2026-09-16/ALIGNMENT.md section 2).
do: Use HSD_JObjSet*, HSD_JObjGet*, and the local inline forms when they represent the operation; use GET_JOBJ only with local evidence.
Use HSD_ASSERT for plain assertions and HSD_ASSERTMSG or HSD_ASSERTREPORT when message or report side effects are real.
In stage TUs, use or add the GroundVars arm owned by that map/stage family; recover item-var fields from the owning Item.xDD4 base.
Use PAD_STACK(N) for intentional stack padding and keep it evidence-bound.
Perform evidenced renames in config/GALE01/symbols.txt and run python configure.py --require-protos when applicable.
do_not: Copy or paste jobj.h inline helper bodies into stage, item, or fighter TUs, or keep expanded __assert("jobj.h", line, ...) when the header inline is identifiable.
Use unrelated union arms such as gv.arwing in another stage TU because the offsets happen to line up.
Replace PAD_STACK(N) with UNUSED u8 sp_pad[N] or similar dummy local buffers.
Hide a symbol rename behind a #define instead of editing config/GALE01/symbols.txt.
qa_enforcement: review; the Melee-path lints copied_jobj_inline, unrolled_assert, and stage_ground_var_owner stay bound to their global records
preferred_repairs: Use header file/line evidence to recover HSD_JObj* helpers or the owning inline.
Restore HSD_ASSERT, HSD_ASSERTMSG, HSD_ASSERTREPORT, OSReport, or OSPanic forms when they represent the source.
Use or add the owning GroundVars/FighterVars/ItemVars arm instead of borrowing unrelated layouts.
Use PAD_STACK(N) for intentional stack padding instead of manual UNUSED sp_pad arrays, and retain it only with recorded objdiff evidence.
Rename in config/GALE01/symbols.txt and update references directly instead of masking duplicate names with a define.
